source: The specifications themselves show why the two columns must be kept separate. From H100 SXM to H200 SXM, the published memory-capacity label rises from 80 GB to 141 GB, about 76%, while peak memory bandwidth rises from 3.35 TB/s to 4.8 TB/s, about 43%. There is no fixed conversion between capacity and bandwidth. They are independent hardware properties with different consequences for a workload.[7][8]
zh: 规格本身说明了为什么两个色谱柱必须分开。从H100 SXM到H200 SXM，公布的内存容量标签从80 GB上升到141 GB，约增加了76％，而峰值内存带宽从3.35 TB / s上升到4.8 TB / s，约43％。容量和带宽之间没有固定的换算。它们是独立的硬件属性，对工作负载具有不同的影响。[7][8]
